Attached: 1 image

Motivation usually shows up after you start, not before. Waiting to feel ready means waiting for something that starting produces.

For the task you keep putting off: write its first visible move, like "open the doc and type the title." Set a timer for two minutes. Do only that move until it rings.

When it rings, you're allowed to stop. Most days the next step is already easier to see.

#motivation #productivity
